pages.quiz:
COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

2. Which statement about Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action .
   D. Explain Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup as rumours only.
   B. Explain Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup.
   D. Say Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen.
   B. Treat Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen as rumours only.
   C. Explain Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen never happens in Kenya.

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

6. Which statement about Support Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Support Systems as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Support Systems.
   C. Say Support Systems never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Support Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Problem Validation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Problem Validation as rumours only.
   B. Explain Problem Validation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Problem Validation.
   D. Say Problem Validation never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Making Important Choices is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Making Important Choices as rumours only.
   B. Say Making Important Choices never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Making Important Choices.
   D. Explain Making Important Choices with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Mombasa

10. Which statement about Building Resilience is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Building Resilience as rumours only.
   B. Explain Building Resilience with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Building Resilience.
   D. Say Building Resilience never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Implementation and Reflection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Implementation and Reflection never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Implementation and Reflection as rumours only.
   C. Explain Implementation and Reflection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Implementation and Reflection.

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Building Resilience and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Support Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Making Important Choices and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. C — Obeying laws and caring for public property

2. D — Explain Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. B — Explain Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. C — Explain Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. D — Explain symbols used on a map

6. D — Explain Support Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. B — Explain Problem Validation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. D — Explain Making Important Choices with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. A — Nairobi

10. B — Explain Building Resilience with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. C — Explain Implementation and Reflection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. C — Plan income and spending wisely

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Building Resilience; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Support Systems; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Making Important Choices; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
